name: atlas
description: Every screen of an app on one version, captured once by the app's own screen walk, filed as one browsable set and diffed against an earlier version.

checkout.description: The app's repository on this host, at the commit being captured. The walk runs from here; its HEAD is recorded as the index's commit.

recipe.description: The app's recipe, relative to checkout: per platform, the walk's command, the pattern its file names follow and its variant names (src/atlas.ts AtlasRecipe).

version.description: The version folder this capture files into, e.g. 0.9.76.

platform.description: Which of the recipe's platforms to walk. Falls back to app.platform, then ios. One device of that platform is walked.

root.description: The atlas folder on this host.

baseline.description: An earlier version in root to diff against; the report goes into <version>/diff-from-<baseline>/.

threshold_pct.description: A shot counts as changed when more than this percent of its pixels differ.

store.description: Copy the version here when done and verify every sha256 there: host:path over ssh (the NAS is mounted on ultra at ~/mnt/photos, so ultra:mnt/photos/atlas) or a local folder.

catalog.description: Also copy index.json and diff.json here, on a local disk the lake's collector can read (launchd cannot read the NAS), e.g. ultra:screen-atlas.
